Hi Martha — thanks for the screenshot, that helps.

Quick troubleshooting: can you try the invite link in an incognito/private window and confirm whether you see the same behavior? Also which IdP does your company use for SSO (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin, etc.)?

My suspicion is the Coupa invite has a RelayState or tenant mapping that is triggering an IdP prompt (we sometimes see an embedded "sandbox"/interstitial when Coupa tenant mapping is ambiguous). If incognito fails we'll reissue the invite using a manual activation flow that bypasses the default SSO binding.

Ben — FYI the PO is currently in pending vendor acceptance. Can you hold any cancelation actions while we resolve?

Laura — can you confirm whether we can resend a manual activation link (non-SSO) for this vendor and what info you need from Martha?

1) Clear cookies for coupa.com or try an incognito/private window (some IdP cookies cause the interstitial to stall).
2) If that doesn't work, I can reissue the invite as a "Manual activation" link that doesn't auto-route to your IdP. That link will let you create a local Coupa account and complete the onboarding forms including the W-9 upload.

If you prefer manual activation, please confirm the exact email address you'd like the invite sent to and whether you want to keep SSO (i.e., if your organization will later request SSO provisioning) or stay with local auth.

I've attached a one-page quick steps doc that walks through the manual activation flow. Internally I'll open a Coupa tenant ticket to verify the IdP RelayState mapping — if it's a tenant-side setting we can request Coupa support to patch it.
